name: What's the difference between a kitchen refresh and a full renovation?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a kitchen refresh and a full renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A kitchen refresh typically involves cosmetic updates without changing the layout or major structural elements. This might include repainting cabinets, replacing hardware, updating light fixtures, or installing a new backsplash. A full renovation, on the other hand, involves more extensive changes, such as reconfiguring the layout, installing new cabinetry, countertops, appliances, and often relocating plumbing or electrical. A full renovation offers a complete transformation, while a refresh provides an updated look at a lower cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: A refresh involves cosmetic updates without layout changes, while a full renovation includes extensive changes like new layouts, cabinetry, and utility relocations.
